info.name: Smart Academic Advisor API
info.description: Advisory-only academic planning API. Run `Auth / Issue a CSRF token` and then `Auth / Authenticate...` first: their tests store {{csrfToken}} and {{accessToken}}. All plans are DRAFT and are never a registration.

item.name: Issue a CSRF token (also sets the csrf_token cookie)

Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
Revoke every refresh session for the current user
Current user, student profile and advisor profile
Change the current password and revoke all sessions
Request a password reset link (always returns the same message)
Consume a reset token and set a new password
Revoke one of the caller's sessions
